title.narrative: Financial Sector Stability and Reforms Program (Subprogram 3)

description.narrative: The principal objective of the Programmatic Approach is to stabilize the Borrower's financial system providing access to finance for businesses in various sectors of the economy. The Programmatic Approach comprises three subprograms and the Program is the third subprogram. The Program scope includes reforms to (a) strengthen the stability and governance of the banking sector; (b) strengthen the asset quality of the banking sector; and (c) deepen sustainable and inclusive finance. The Program is described in more detail in the Policy Letter and the PDMF.
